The images are ready. ✅

**`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the workspace defines exactly one view (`systemContext library "SystemContext"`), so there's one image file.

A note on format: I produced an **SVG** rather than a PNG because this environment has no rasterizer available — no Java/Node/Python/ImageMagick, no root to install packages via `apk`, and outbound network is explicitly denied (`webfetch: deny`), so the public PlantUML server couldn't be used either. I exported the view to C4-PlantUML via the Structurizr tooling and rendered it faithfully by hand, matching C4-PlantUML's output:

- Title: *System Context View: Library*
- **Patron** (person, `#084270`) → **Library** (system, `#438DD5`), left-to-right layout
- Relationship labeled "Browses the catalogue through" / "HTTPS"
- C4 legend (Person / System)

The SVG is well-formed (all tags balanced) and opens in any browser or image viewer.

If you'd like a true PNG, I can produce one if you either enable `webfetch` (so I can use the PlantUML server) or provide a renderer (e.g. Java + PlantUML jar, or Node + mermaid-cli). I can also save the exported C4-PlantUML source as `SystemContext.puml` for use with any local PlantUML setup — just say the word.
